title: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for which the ave
question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for which the average organization key within each organization key group is greater than the overall average organization key across all organizations, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group, the DLC key, the number of organizations in the group, the minimum organization number in the group, the most prominent major organization name in the group (i.e., the major organization name with the highest count of organizations), and that count. Order the results by space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
         o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
         o.DESCRIPTION,
         o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
         o.MAJOR_ORG,
         o.DLC_KEY,
         s.SPACE_UNIT,
         s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY
  WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '5'
),
grp AS (
  SELECT MAJOR_ORG,
         AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS avg_key,
         COUNT(*) AS org_count,
         MIN(CAST(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS min_org_number
  FROM base
  GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS overall_avg
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION
),
top AS (
  SELECT MAJOR_ORG,
         MAJOR_ORG AS top_major_org,
         COUNT(*) AS top_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MAJOR_ORG ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAJOR_ORG) AS rn
  FROM base
  GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG, MAJOR_ORG
)
SELECT b.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
       b.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
       b.DESCRIPTION,
       b.SPACE_UNIT,
       b.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
       g.avg_key,
       b.DLC_KEY,
       g.org_count,
       g.min_org_number,
       t.top_major_org,
       t.top_count
FROM base b
JOIN grp g ON b.MAJOR_ORG = g.MAJOR_ORG
JOIN overall o ON g.avg_key > o.overall_avg
JOIN top t ON b.MAJOR_ORG = t.MAJOR_ORG AND t.rn = 1
ORDER BY b.SPACE_UNIT_KEY

WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
         o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
         o.DESCRIPTION,
         o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
         o.MAJOR_ORG,
         o.DLC_KEY,
         s.SPACE_UNIT,
         s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY
  WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '5'
),
grp AS (
  SELECT MAJOR_ORG,
         AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS avg_key,
         COUNT(*) AS org_count,
         MIN(CAST(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS min_org_number
  FROM base
  GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS overall_avg
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION
),
top AS (
  SELECT MAJOR_ORG,
         MAJOR_ORG AS top_major_org,
         COUNT(*) AS top_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MAJOR_ORG ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAJOR_ORG) AS rn
  FROM base
  GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG, MAJOR_ORG
)
SELECT b.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
       b.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
       b.DESCRIPTION,
       b.SPACE_UNIT,
       b.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
       g.avg_key,
       b.DLC_KEY,
       g.org_count,
       g.min_org_number,
       t.top_major_org,
       t.top_count
FROM base b
JOIN grp g ON b.MAJOR_ORG = g.MAJOR_ORG
JOIN overall o ON g.avg_key > o.overall_avg
JOIN top t ON b.MAJOR_ORG = t.MAJOR_ORG AND t.rn = 1
ORDER BY b.SPACE_UNIT_KEY

WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
         o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
         o.DESCRIPTION,
         o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
         o.MAJOR_ORG,
         o.DLC_KEY,
         s.SPACE_UNIT,
         s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY
  WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '5'
),
grp AS (
  SELECT MAJOR_ORG,
         AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS avg_key,
         COUNT(*) AS org_count,
         MIN(CAST(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS min_org_number
  FROM base
  GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS overall_avg
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION
),
top AS (
  SELECT MAJOR_ORG,
         MAJOR_ORG AS top_major_org,
         COUNT(*) AS top_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MAJOR_ORG ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAJOR_ORG) AS rn
  FROM base
  GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG, MAJOR_ORG
)
SELECT b.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
       b.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
       b.DESCRIPTION,
       b.SPACE_UNIT,
       b.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
       g.avg_key,
       b.DLC_KEY,
       g.org_count,
       g.min_org_number,
       t.top_major_org,
       t.top_count
FROM base b
JOIN grp g ON b.MAJOR_ORG = g.MAJOR_ORG
JOIN overall o ON g.avg_key > o.overall_avg
JOIN top t ON b.MAJOR_ORG = t.MAJOR_ORG AND t.rn = 1
ORDER BY b.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
